items.name: Trans Lifeline
items.text: (877) 565-8860, Mon–Fri 10 am–6 pm Pacific. Trans and nonbinary peers; you don’t have to be in crisis or sure you’re trans.

items.name: Spectrum Center Spokane
items.text: LGBTQ+ center, 1514 N Monroe St. Free one-on-one gender doula (sign up; may be a waitlist). Groups are for youth and caregivers.

verified.note: the page shows example dates from 2025; recheck

items.name: Ingersoll Gender Center
items.text: Seattle trans peer groups and a provider database. info@ingersollgendercenter.org.

items.name: Planned Parenthood, Spokane
items.text: Hormones by informed consent (18+), no therapist letter. 123 E Indiana Ave, Bldg A, Mon–Fri 8–6. Telehealth by video, phone or messaging. (866) 904-7721.
items.check: hours Mon-Fri 8-6, age 18+, telehealth modes: call (866) 904-7721 first

items.name: Driver’s license
items.text: Change the marker to M, F or X in person or by mail; no doctor’s note. New card is free if only the marker changes.

items.name: Birth certificate
items.text: Adults: M, F or X with a notarized form. Free to amend; certified copies $25.

items.name: Court name change
items.text: Can cost over $300; ask for a fee waiver. Gender-related changes can be sealed.
items.check: "over $300" and sealing are not on an official page (fee waiver rule GR 34 is)

items.name: Gonzaga Law ID clinic
items.text: Free monthly help with name and gender marker changes, notary included. Dates on Instagram @zaglawcivilrights.

items.name: Trans-Wa
items.text: Name/ID clinics were paused in spring 2026 and are planned to restart Oct 2026; email first. services@transwa.org.

verified.source: https://www.transwa.org/ (search of transwa.org, May 2026; page captcha-blocked)
verified.note: partly: recheck in October 2026 that clinics restarted

items.name: Federal IDs
items.text: Passport and Social Security rules changed in 2025; ask a clinic first.

items.name: Point of Pride
items.text: Free femme shapewear; funds for HRT, hair removal, and a Thrive Fund (wigs, voice training, more). pointofpride.org.
